title: A $G$-Invariant Erdős--Hanani Theorem with Applications to Optical Orthogonal and Constant-Weight Codes
summary: Let $k>t\ge 2$ be fixed integers, and let $G$ be a permutation group on a set of $v$ points. A $G$-invariant packing is free if every block has $|G|$ distinct images under $G$. We give two conditions on $G$ under which, as $v\to\infty$, there is a free $G$-invariant $t$-$(v,k,1)$ packing with $(1-o(1))\binom{v}{t}/\binom{k}{t}$ blocks. This is a $G$-invariant form of the Erdős--Hanani theorem on asymptotically optimal packings.
